realizes.rationale: Renders all three zoom levels stacked in static/script-off/print HTML and upgrades after hydration to keyboard-navigable roving-tabindex tabs with shareable ?level= URL state.

1.note:
Defines the three zoom tabs (`abitur`/`undergrad`/`lean` mapped to `level1`/`level2`/`level3` slots), `pageId` prop and pre-hydration `hydrated = false` state.

Anchor: `TABS`

2.note:
Parses `?level=` and `#level-*` deep links (`parseLevelFromUrl`), syncs `?level=` via `history.replaceState` (`syncUrl`) and handles `ArrowLeft`/`ArrowRight`/`Home`/`End` keyboard navigation (`onTabKeydown`).

Anchor: `onTabKeydown`

3.note:
Progressively enhances from script-off static jump nav and stacked panels to WAI-ARIA `tablist`/`tabpanel` controls with roving `tabindex` and print-restorable headings.

Anchor: `rh-zoom-tablist`
